_comment: Canonical L3 approval wire shapes. ApprovalCompletedEvent is the SSE event payload emitted when an L3 decision resumes a suspended transaction; it carries the executing Operator's signed ActionReceipt, which is the only proof of the outcome. SuspendedTransaction is a transaction awaiting L3 human approval; it holds no approval or proof material, which lives only in the governance envelope and the receipt. Serialized from ApprovalCompletedEvent (internal/models/approval.go) and SuspendedTransaction (internal/models/suspended.go).

approval_completed_event._description: SSE event payload for an L3 decision on a suspended transaction. Emitted by the gateway after the decided transaction resumes; clients report approval only when the receipt names tx_hash, completed, and carries a valid required L3 proof.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the decided transaction

receipt.description: Canonical protojson ztd.operator.v1.ActionReceipt of the resumed transaction, signed by the executing Operator. A denial carries a receipt with rejection code L3_DENIED.

suspended_transaction._description: A transaction awaiting L3 human approval. Stored in the suspended transactions store.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that triggered the suspension

user_id.description: User ID that initiated the transaction

operator_id.description: Operator ID that submitted the transaction

operator_session_id.description: Operator session the envelope targets; owns the approval audit chain

submitter_cli_session_id.description: CLI session that submitted the transaction. Omitted when not set.

expected_cert_fingerprint.description: Expected mTLS cert fingerprint for verification. Omitted when not set.

claimed_at.description: Set while an approved transaction is being executed; a claimed row is never recorded as expired. Omitted when unclaimed.
